director.text: Namaste Riya! Main Asha, tumhari AI teacher. Aaj fractions ko number line par rakhenge—cricket pitch jaise. Cricket mein tumhe kya pasand hai?
samajh nahi aaya

Cricket pitch ko ek number line socho: ek stump 0 par hai aur doosra stump 1 par. Batsman run ke liye bhaaga aur theek beech mein ruk gaya. Woh pitch ke ek pakke spot par khada hai, aur us spot ka bhi ek number hota hai.
haan samajh gayi
Screen par 0 se 1 ki line hai, aur beech ka mark 2 barabar gaps banata hai; uska naam 1/2 hai. Zoya ka kehna hai ki 1/3, 3 ke paas aata hai. 1/3 kahaan hai: isi 0 se 1 wali line par, ya 3 ke paas?

director.text: near 3

Woh sadak ke ek pakke spot par khada hai, aur us spot ka number 1/2 km hai, 0 aur 1 ke beech. Wahi 0 se 1 km ki sadak ab 8 barabar hisson mein bati hai. Khilona pehle hisse ke end par ruka. Woh kis number par hai?

Screen par wahi 0 se 1 ki line hai, par ab beech mein 3 marks hain. Marks nahi, gaps dekho: 4 barabar gaps hain, isliye 0 ke baad pehla mark 1/4 hai. Agar 0 aur 1 ke beech 7 marks barabar doori par lage hon, toh line kitne barabar gaps mein bategi?

Iska shuruaati hissa dekhte hain. Ghar 0 par hai aur school 1 km par. Ghar aur school ke beech raaste mein 3 bijli ke khambe barabar doori par lage hain. Pehla khamba ghar se kitne km door hai? Diya hai: ghar 0 par, school 1 km par, beech mein 3 khambe, barabar doori par. Dhoondhna hai: pehle khambe ki ghar se doori, km mein. Ab tak samajh aaya?
pata nahi, aap batao

0 se 1 tak beech ke 3 khambe 4 barabar gaps banayenge. Line banao aur ghar ko 0 par, school ko 1 par likho: 0 se 1 tak ki line, kyunki 0 se 1 tak ka poora raasta hi humara ek poora hai. Yeh kadam saaf hai?
haan
Accha, batane ke liye thanks! Khambe nahi, beech ke gaps gino: 3 khambe, toh 4 barabar hisse, kyunki beech ke marks se gaps hamesha ek zyada hote hain. Yahan tak theek hai?
